EnrollmentCreated.short-token.json.note: Tokens have at least 256 bits of entropy.

ErrorEnvelope.unknown-code.json.note: Only codes from pkg/apierr are allowed.

MemberDetail.refund-is-not-a-state.json.note: Refunds are billing events, not entitlement states (§9.2).

MemberPatch.unknown-field.json.note: Billing facts cannot be edited through PATCH.

NodePatch.unknown-field.json.note: Only allowlisted fields can be patched; publication uses its own endpoint.

ObservationReport.negative-seq.json.note: Sequence numbers are unsigned decimal strings.

Operation.not-a-status.json.note: `completed` is not an operation status; 202 is never shown as completed.

UpdateBatchRetryRequest.empty-targets.js.note: Omit target_ids to retry all; an empty list is ambiguous.

UsageBatchRequest.empty.json.note: A batch carries at least one event.

EnrollmentCreateRequest.bad-node-id.json.note: Existing Node identifier for AT07 must be a UUID.

UpdateTarget.missing-needs-attention.jso.note: Target attention and confirmation flags must always be explicit.

UpdateTarget.missing-unconfirmed.json.note: Target attention and confirmation flags must always be explicit.

AgentBootstrap.missing-setup-key.json.note: D-015 success has exactly the three required bootstrap delivery members.

OperationKind.unapproved-value.json.note: Only orchestrator-approved enum additions are valid.

ResourceType.unapproved-value.json.note: Only orchestrator-approved enum additions are valid.

ErrorCode.unapproved-value.json.note: Only orchestrator-approved enum additions are valid.
